That is still among the living--still occupied with dispensing aid and comfort to the suffering and the afflicted, for the original is that of a Queen, beloved as widely as her realms extend--the best of sovereigns, the kindest-hearted of women."

arxiv-1409-1150.title: Towards a Simplified Dynamic Wake Model Using POD Analysis
arxiv-1409-1150.creator: David Bastine *, Björn Witha, Matthias Wächter, Joachim Peinke
arxiv-1409-1150.description: Abstract We apply a modified proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) to large eddy simulation data of a wind turbine wake in a turbulent atmospheric boundary layer. The turbine is modeled as an actuator disk. Our analysis mainly focuses on the pragmatic identification of spatial modes, which yields a low order description of the wake flow.

arxiv-1611-04745.title: Recent results from the NA61/SHINE strong interaction physics programme
arxiv-1611-04745.creator: Evgeny Andronov \fnsep, for the NA61/SHINE Collaboration
arxiv-1611-04745.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Evgeny Andronov \fnsep, for the NA61/SHINE Collaboration. The main physics goals of the NA61/SHINE programme on strong interactions are the study of the properties of the onset of deconfinement and the search for signatures of the critical point of strongly interacting matter. For this purpose a scan of the two dimensional phase diagram ( T T - μ B \mu_{B} ) is being performed at the SPS by measurements of hadron production in nucleus-nucleus collisions as a function of collision energy and system size.

arxiv-1911-04232.title: Statistical Analysis of weather variables of Antofagasta
arxiv-1911-04232.creator: H. Farfan † 1 {}^{\dagger}{}^{1}, S. Curilef 1 and A. Castillo 2
arxiv-1911-04232.description: Abstract The statistical behavior of weather variables of Antofagasta is described, especially the daily data of air as temperature, pressure and relative humidity measured at 08:00, 14:00 and 20:00. In this article, we use a time series deseasonalization technique, Q-Q plot, skewness, kurtosis and the Pearson correlation coefficient.

arxiv-2110-10400.title: Modular commutator in gapped quantum many-body systems
arxiv-2110-10400.creator: Isaac H. Kim, Bowen Shi, Kohtaro Kato, Victor V. Albert
arxiv-2110-10400.description: Abstract In arXiv:2110.06932 , we argued that the chiral central charge — a topologically protected quantity characterizing the edge theory of a gapped (2+1)-dimensional system — can be extracted from the bulk by using an order parameter called the modular commutator.

arxiv-2203-01131.title: MuMuPy: A Dimuonium-Matter Interaction Calculator Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2203-01131.creator: Artem Uskov, Abdaljalel Alizzi, Zurab Silagadze
arxiv-2203-01131.description: Abstract In this article, we present MuMuPy, a computational library and cloud-based tool for calculating cross sections for the interaction of dimuonium (true muonium) with matter. MuMuPy calculates corresponding form factors and allows one to find the probabilities of dimuonium transitions in the electric field of the nucleus.

arxiv-2208-07545.title: Lusternik-Schnirelmann theory to Topological Complexity from A ∞ A_{\infty} -view point Thanks: The author was supported in part by Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (S) #17H06128 and by Exploratory Research #18K18713 from Japan Society for the Promotion of Science.
arxiv-2208-07545.creator: Norio Iwase
arxiv-2208-07545.description: Abstract . We are trying to look over the Lusternik-Schnirelmann theory (L-S theory, for short) and the Topological Complexity (TC, for short) as a natural extension of the L-S theory. In particular, we focus on the impact of the ideas originated from E. Fadell and S. Husseini on both theories.

arxiv-2209-11882.title: Logarithmically larger deletion codes of all distances
arxiv-2209-11882.creator: Noga Alon, Gabriela Bourla, Ben Graham, Xiaoyu He, Noah Kravitz
arxiv-2209-11882.description: Abstract The deletion distance between two binary words u , v ∈ { 0 , 1 } n u,v\in\{0,1\}^{n} is the smallest k k such that u u and v v share a common subsequence of length n − k n-k .

arxiv-2211-15500.title: RF Properties and Their Variations in a 3D printed Klystron Circuit and Cavities
arxiv-2211-15500.creator: Charlotte Wehner, Julian Merrick, Bradley Shirley, Brandon Weatherford, Garrett Mathesen, Emilio Nanni
arxiv-2211-15500.description: Abstract Presently, the manufacturing of active RF devices like klystrons is dominated by expensive and time consuming cycles of machining and brazing. In this article we characterize the RF properties of X-band klsytron cavities and an integrated circuit manufactured with a novel additive manufacturing process.

arxiv-2305-03361.title: CHAMELEON: OutSystems Live Bidirectional Transformations
arxiv-2305-03361.creator: Hugo Lourenço, João Costa Seco, Carla Ferreira, Tiago Simões, Vasco Silva, Filipe Assunção, André Menezes
arxiv-2305-03361.description: Abstract In model-driven engineering, the bidirectional transformation of models plays a crucial role in facilitating the use of editors that operate at different levels of abstraction. This is particularly important in the context of industrial-grade low-code platforms like OutSystems, which feature a comprehensive ecosystem of tools that complement the standard integrated development environment with domain-specific builders and abstract model viewers.

arxiv-2306-05027.title: Hybrid Logical-Physical Qubit Interaction as a Post Selection Oracle
arxiv-2306-05027.creator: Nadav Carmel, Nadav Katz
arxiv-2306-05027.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nadav Carmel, Nadav Katz. We demonstrate a property of the quantum 5-qubit stabilizer code that enables the interaction between qubits of different logical layers, and conduct a full density-matrix simulation of an interaction between a logical and a physical qubit. We use the logical qubit as an ancilla and find under which circumstances it gives an advantage over the bare physical ancilla approach, changing the circuit depth and noise level with decoherence processes at play.

arxiv-2307-13128.title: Explaining Math Word Problem Solvers DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: NLP ; December; Bangkok, Thailand CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks Conference: 2022 6th International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval; December 16–18, 2022; Bangkok, Thailand 2022 6t
arxiv-2307-13128.creator: Abby Newcomb, Jugal Kalita
arxiv-2307-13128.description: Abstract . Automated math word problem solvers based on neural networks have successfully managed to obtain 70-80% accuracy in solving arithmetic word problems. However, it has been shown that these solvers may rely on superficial patterns to obtain their equations.

arxiv-2308-12704.title: Embedding Ultra slow-roll inflaton dynamics in Warm Inflation
arxiv-2308-12704.creator: Sandip Biswas, Kaushik Bhattacharya, Suratna Das
arxiv-2308-12704.description: Abstract Slow-roll of the inflaton field defines the standard dynamics of the inflationary epoch. However, the inflationary system deviates from slow-roll when it encounters an extremely flat region of the inflaton potential, and enters a phase dubbed Ultra slow roll.

arxiv-2502-03214.title: iVISPAR — An Interactive Visual-Spatial Reasoning Benchmark for VLMs
arxiv-2502-03214.creator: Julius Mayer, Mohamad Ballout, Serwan Jassim, Farbod Nosrat Nezami, Elia Bruni
arxiv-2502-03214.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are known to struggle with spatial reasoning and visual alignment. To help overcome these limitations, we introduce iVISPAR, an interactive multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of VLMs acting as agents. iVISPAR is based on a variant of the sliding tile puzzle—a classic problem that demands logical planning, spatial awareness, and multi-step reasoning.

arxiv-2503-04030.title: Self-Supervised Large Scale Point Cloud Completion for Archaeological Site Restoration Figure 1 : Restoration results of applying our method on a large structure consisting of 15 million points from Mawchu Llacta in Peru. The structure is completed and displayed over the original site for visualizat
arxiv-2503-04030.creator: Aocheng Li, James R. Zimmer-Dauphinee, Rajesh Kalyanam, Ian Lindsay
arxiv-2503-04030.description: Abstract Point cloud completion helps restore partial incomplete point clouds suffering occlusions. Current self-supervised methods fail to give high fidelity completion for large objects with missing surfaces and unbalanced distribution of available points. In this paper, we present a novel method for restoring large-scale point clouds with limited and unbalanced ground-truth.

pmc-10543412.title: Reintroducing Fenfluramine as a Treatment for Seizures: Current Knowledge, Recommendations and Gaps in Understanding
pmc-10543412.creator: Gianluca Dini, Giuseppe Di Cara, Pietro Ferrara, Pasquale Striano, Alberto Verrotti
pmc-10543412.description: Despite the introduction of new anti-seizure medications in recent years, approximately one-third of the epileptic population continues to experience seizures. Recently, the anti-obesity medication fenfluramine (FFA) has been successfully repurposed, and it has received approval from various regulatory agencies for the treatment of seizures associated with Dravet syndrome and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.

pmc-10648122.title: SUMOylation Modulates Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) Levels and Acts as a Protective Mechanism in the Type 2 Model of Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy
pmc-10648122.creator: Nicolas Mandel, Michael Büttner, Gernot Poschet, Rohini Kuner, Nitin Agarwal, Alexander E Kalyuzhny
pmc-10648122.description: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is the prevalent type of peripheral neuropathy; it primarily impacts extremity nerves. Its multifaceted nature makes the molecular mechanisms of diabetic neuropathy intricate and incompletely elucidated. Several types of post-translational modifications (PTMs) have been implicated in the development and progression of DPN, including phosphorylation, glycation, acetylation and SUMOylation.

pmc-11311218.title: Coassembly of Complementary Polyhedral Metal–Organic Framework Particles into Binary Ordered Superstructures
pmc-11311218.creator: Lingxin Meng, Javier Fonseca, Roberto Sánchez-Naya, Amir Mohammad Ghadiri, Inhar Imaz, Daniel Maspoch
pmc-11311218.description: Here we report the formation of a 3D NaCl-type binary porous superstructure via coassembly of two colloidal polyhedral metal–organic framework (MOF) particles having complementary sizes, shapes, and charges. We employed a polymeric-attenuated Coulombic self-assembly approach, which also facilitated the coassembly of these MOF particles with spherical polystyrene particles to form 2D binary superstructures.

pmc-11312754.title: Inflammation, Oxidative Stress, and Endothelial Dysfunction in the Pathogenesis of Vascular Damage: Unraveling Novel Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Fabry Disease
pmc-11312754.creator: Denise Cristiana Faro, Francesco Lorenzo Di Pino, Ines Paola Monte, Antonio Barbato
pmc-11312754.description: Anderson-Fabry disease (AFD), a genetic disorder caused by mutations in the α-galactosidase-A (GLA) gene, disrupts lysosomal function, leading to vascular complications. The accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) in arterial walls triggers upregulation of adhesion molecules, decreases endothelial nitric oxide synthesis, and induces reactive oxygen species production. This cascade results in fibrotic thickening, endothelial dysfunction, hypercontractility, vasospasm, and a pro-thrombotic phenotype.

pmc-11468804.title: Self‐Emulsifying Drug Delivery Systems (SEDDS) Containing Reverse Micelles: Advanced Oral Formulations for Therapeutic Peptides
pmc-11468804.creator: Arne Matteo Jörgensen, Christian Steinbring, Daniel Stengel, Dennis To, Pascal Schmid, Andreas Bernkop‐Schnürch
pmc-11468804.description: Alternative methods to hydrophobic ion pairing for the formation of lipophilic complexes of peptide drugs to incorporate them in lipid‐based nanocarriers such as self‐emulsifying drug delivery systems (SEDDS) for oral administration are highly on demand. Such an alternative might be reverse micelles.

pmc-11713102.title: Anti‐amyloid‐β treatment effects on dominantly inherited Alzheimer disease neuropathology: comparing autopsy findings with biomarker outcomes from the DIAN‐TU‐001 trial of gantenerumab or solanezumab
pmc-11713102.creator: Charles D Chen, Erin E Franklin, Yan Li, Nelly Joseph‐Mathurin, Aime Burns, Diana A Hobbs, Austin A McCullough, Stephanie A Schultz, Guoqiao Wang, Tammie LS Benzinger, Randall J Bateman, Richard J Perrin
pmc-11713102.description: BackgroundClinical trials of anti‐Aβ monoclonal antibodies in Alzheimer disease (AD) typically infer target engagement from Aβ positron emission tomography (PET) and/or cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) Aβ42/40 biomarker outcomes that measure Aβ deposits indirectly and/or incompletely. Assessment of postmortem tissue is needed to directly investigate treatment effects on Aβ deposits.

pmc-12589575.title: Regional patterns of global industrial energy demands as a foundation for modelling decarbonization pathways
pmc-12589575.creator: Anđelka Kerekeš, Arne Burdack, Ganesh Deepak Rupakula, Felix Lippkau, Heidi Heinrichs, Philipp Kuhn, Detlef Stolten, Jochen Linßen, Markus Blesl, Thomas Hamacher
pmc-12589575.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Decarbonisation of the industry sector is particularly challenging given its huge energy demand and high complexity of its various production processes. Additionally, regional differences in energy demand patterns affect the possible transition pathways. This study assesses energy demands of the five most energy-intensive industries iron and steel, non-ferrous metals, non-metallic minerals, pulp and paper, and chemicals for 2018, the most recent year not affected by the Covid-19 pandemic for 16 exemplary world regions of the TIAM global energy system model.

pmc-12621613.title: Comparison of urodynamic findings in patients with suprasacral spinal cord injury according to the time of injury
pmc-12621613.creator: Zuhal Ozisler, Meltem Güneş Akıncı
pmc-12621613.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objectives This study aims to investigate the reflex bladder’s occurrence according to urodynamic parameters in patients with suprasacral spinal cord injury (SCI) within one year after injury. Patients and methods Between May 2021 and July 2023, a total of 83 (57 males, 26 females; median age: 32 years; range, 19 to 64 years) suprasacral traumatic SCI patients within one year after injury were included in the study.

pmc-13078847.title: Interpreting Risk and Impact Measures in Nursing Research: Implications for Evidence-based Practice
pmc-13078847.creator: R. Mauricio Barría P.
pmc-13078847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To analyze the conceptual foundations, calculation, and interpretation of key risk and impact measures used in nursing research, emphasizing their relevance for evidence-based clinical practice. This article reviews measures of risk or association, including relative risk, odds ratio, and hazard ratio, as well as absolute impact measures, such as risk difference, absolute and relative risk reduction, absolute risk increase, and numbers needed to treat and harm.

pmc-13201809.title: Genetic Landscape of Oral Carcinoma Cuniculatum and its Histological Mimics
pmc-13201809.creator: Sawako Ono, Yuki Fukawa, Katsutoshi Hirose, Yumiko Hori, Daisuke Motooka, Hiroyuki Harada, Eiichi Morii, Satoru Toyosawa, Naozumi Ishimaru, Hidetaka Yamamoto
pmc-13201809.description: PurposeOral carcinoma cuniculatum (CC) is a rare variant of oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), characterized by a well-differentiated, burrowing invasive pattern and minimal cellular atypia. Its diagnosis is challenging owing to its bland morphology, which makes differentiation from non-neoplastic lesions difficult on biopsy. Despite this, CC often requires distinction from conventional OSCC, even in surgical specimens.

pmc-13218182.title: Preferences of women experiencing infertility for in vitro fertilisation treatment in China: a discrete choice experiment
pmc-13218182.creator: Liyong Lu, Yuyu Lv, Hongwei Nie, Shan Jiang, Shi Zhao, Ling Geng, Haipeng Wang, Shunping Li
pmc-13218182.description: IntroductionIn vitro fertilisation (IVF) is a key treatment for infertility, but uptake and continuation may be limited by treatment burden, side effects and out-of-pocket costs. Evidence on IVF treatment preferences among women in China remains limited. This study examined the preferences of Chinese women experiencing infertility for different IVF treatment attributes.

pmc-13376866.title: Spatial distribution characteristics and protection strategies of National intangible cultural heritage in the Pearl river basin
pmc-13376866.creator: Ying Wang, Rong Yu, Jiaying Hu
pmc-13376866.description: While the spatial analysis of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) is well-established at national and provincial scales, cross-jurisdictional river basins remain a critical research gap. This study investigates the spatial heterogeneity of 289 national-level ICH items within China’s Pearl River Basin to inform regional conservation planning.

pmc-13469315.title: Lactoferrin as a Novel Therapeutic Agent in Dermatology: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives
pmc-13469315.creator: Hui Zhang, Xu He, Peisheng Chen, Shanhe Shen, Qibin Liu, Xinling Bi
pmc-13469315.description: LTF is a multifunctional natural glycoprotein with antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. These biological activities have led to growing interest in its potential applications in dermatology. This review summarizes current evidence on the role of LTF in melanoma, acne, psoriasis, wound healing, and related inflammatory skin disorders.

pmc-13476496.title: From Evidence to Action: Addressing Micronutrient Gaps among Women of Reproductive Age in Malawi Using the Comprehensive Nutrient Gap Assessment Framework
pmc-13476496.creator: Zione Kalumikiza-Chikumbu, Bridget Mkama-Maliya, Gareth Osman, Alexander A Kalimbira

pmc-13571582.title: Non-canonical activation of VEGFA through TIMM44-dependent mitochondrial remodelling
pmc-13571582.creator: Tanvi Chaudhary, Sharath Mohan Bhat, Priyadarshika Pradhan, Manjunath B. Joshi, Devanjan Sinha
pmc-13571582.description: Coordination of mitochondrial functional states with nuclear transcriptional programs remain critical for cellular adaptation. Here, we identify mitochondrial protein import capacity as a regulator of redox-dependent signalling in tumour cells. We show that the mitochondrial import motor component TIMM44, which is upregulated in angiogenesis-driven tumours, drives respiratory remodelling without increasing mitochondrial abundance.

pmc-7618570.title: Epigenetic clocks and programmatic aging
pmc-7618570.creator: David Gems, Roop Singh Virk, João Pedro de Magalhaes
pmc-7618570.description: The last decade has seen remarkable progress in the characterization of methylation clocks that can serve as indicators of biological age in humans and many other mammalian species. While the biological processes of aging that underlie these clocks have remained unclear, several clues have pointed to a link to developmental mechanisms.
